description: The SPA is served by the local sidecar over http://127.0.0.1:<port>, i.e. a 'remote' origin as far as Tauri IPC is concerned. With titleBarStyle Overlay there is no native title bar left to grab, and data-tauri-drag-region needs __TAURI_INTERNALS__ to invoke start_dragging — so this grants IPC to the local origin, restricted to exactly the two window-drag commands and nothing else.
